profile.headline: Talent Engineer @MatX // ex-Meta Production Engineer 👾
profile.summary:
Cloud-minded and dog-focused. Ask about my Boston 🐾

My SRE expertise extends into live traffic monitoring, server overload protection, enforcement + ideation of capacity planning, as well as making lots of pretty dashboards for the rest of the backend microservice teams to keep pace 📈📈

positions.title: Production Engineer
positions.locationName: Menlo Park, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Core Infra - Reliability

* Perform server overload protection for 10+ core services across global data center origins
* Maintain Meta's core load balancer, performing live routing table updates
* Align load balancing with company capacity planning initiatives for cost auditing of core services

See our whitepaper! ➡️ https://tinyurl.com/bdh2xjev
positions.insights: Skills: Capacity Planning · Site Reliability Engineering · Network Traffic Analysis

positions.title: Cloud Engineer
positions.description:
•    Created a Docker-based GitLab CI/CD pipeline for backend validation
•    Designed multi-faceted architecture diagrams for FDA presub 
•    Optimized cloud compute & storage to reduce backend costs by over 40%
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Docker Products · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Cloud Infrastructure · Amazon EBS

positions.title: Cloud Lead
positions.description:
● Acted as sole cloud staff to perform client calls, implementing all AWS infra first-hand
● Highlight: Implementing a VPN from scratch for a top-3 healthcare provider in the US
● Regularly met with non-technical QA staff to update cloud-facing regulatory policies
positions.insights: Skills: PostgreSQL · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · RESTful WebServices

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description:
Throughout the month of February, I had the pleasure of scaling Canopay's core platform - through migrating from non-relational to relational databases, converging on AWS as a cloud provider, and explaining best long-term scalability measures to the team, I was able to grow my capacity as a product leader!

See my attached post, which performs a deeper dive into my areas of growth!
positions.insights: Skills: Data Modeling · Product Management · Database Design · Java · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Collaborating with colleagues to carve through complex open-ended issues in the field of electrical vehicle telemetry, smart charging, and fleet management.

Had the pleasure of researching, scoping out, architecting, and implementing high-impact capabilities such as V2G (vehicle-to-grid) event integration, to enable charging depots to be awarded rebates from their utility providers.
positions.insights: Skills: Normalization · Software Development · Docker Products · Databases · Data Warehousing · API Development · Spring Framework · Data Science · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · RESTful WebServices

positions.title: (IC3) Software Engineer
positions.description: Though impacted by Coinbase's indiscriminate layoff of 18% of the company on June 14th, 2022, 3 weeks into my employment, I exhibited rapid growth throughout the onboarding process. Along with implementing strong team collaboration strategies during my bootcamp project, all the way through final project presentations, I was able to pick up GoLang and gRPC to add to my technical skillset!
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Blockchain · Full-Stack Development · gRPC · Team Management · Go (Programming Language) · Teamwork

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Collaborated on client-facing projects, utilizing the Salesforce platform, in order to ensure positive customer experiences. This included a large focus on CRM and user-facing components, e.g. client discussions on project requirements and desired feature implementations, as well as a strong skillset in JavaScript, Apex, and SQL components.

positions.title: Explorer Intern
positions.description:
Worked on a 3-intern software project in the End-User Experience branch of Microsoft Managed Desktop, acting as a full-stack developer.

During this internship, I learned frontend code practices on-the-job (C# and XAML), and was able to expand on my backend skillset in SQL and the Swagger web framework.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · API Development · RESTful WebServices

positions.title: Head Lab TA for CS252: Systems Programming
positions.description: Acted as Head TA for one of the lab sections of CS252: Systems Programming; along with the typical Undergraduate TA roles of helping students understand coding assignments and answering questions, I presented each new lab assignment and inputted student grades into Blackboard. I also proctored exams for CS252 while in this role.

positions.title: Lab TA for CS250: Computer Architecture
positions.description: In this position, I help students learn the basics of Computer Hardware. I also answer questions concerning lab assignments, focusing on breadboard circuitry, Raspberry Pi basics, and ARM assembly coding.

positions.title: IT Intern
positions.description:
Worked with SmartTrailer team to create a mobile yard-checking application; utilized Couchbase, Angular 6, OpenShift, Spring Boot, and other software tools on a 4-intern team.

During this internship, I had the opportunity to participate in a UPS Hackathon. My team received the Cutting Edge award, and was one of few selected to present to UPS CIEO Juan Perez.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · API Development · Spring Framework · Jenkins · RESTful WebServices

positions.title: Lab TA for CS240: Introduction to C/C++
positions.description: Worked as a CS240 Teaching Assistant for lab sections, helping freshman with introductory C/C++ lab assignments. Proctored exams and graded homeworks for two lab sections, four hours a week; also answered student questions online.
